def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    x = int(inputs['X'])
    a, b, c, k = (int(inputs[z]) for z in ('A','B','C','K'))
    mask = (1 << 32) - 1
    for _ in range(k):
        x ^= (x << a) & mask
        x &= mask
        x ^= x >> b
        x &= mask
        x ^= (x << c) & mask
        x &= mask
    return float(x)
